record.field: Entry-level security guard position. Responsible for basic security duties including access control, patrol, and monitoring. Must hold valid SIRA Grade 1 certification issued by Dubai Police.
Senior-level security guard with advanced responsibilities. Handles complex security situations, leads small teams, and performs specialized duties. Must hold valid SIRA Grade 2 certification.
Security supervisor responsible for overseeing guard teams, shift management, and operational coordination. Must hold valid SIRA Grade 3 certification and demonstrate leadership capabilities.
Security manager overseeing entire security operations, client relationships, compliance, and strategic planning. Must hold valid SIRA Grade 4 certification.
Monitors CCTV, access control systems, and alarm systems. Coordinates with field guards and emergency services. Minimum SIRA Grade 1 required.
Front desk security officer managing visitor access, screening, and customer service. Minimum SIRA Grade 1 required.
Conducts mobile patrols across multiple sites, responds to alarms, and performs security checks. Valid UAE driving license and SIRA Grade 1 required.
Specializes in event security, crowd control, and VIP protection. SIRA Grade 1 minimum with additional event security training.
Specialized in fire safety systems, emergency evacuation, and life safety compliance. Requires SIRA Grade 2 and Civil Defense certification.
Works in industrial facilities with specialized security needs. SIRA Grade 1 with HSE awareness training required.
